voice.style_prompt: Read aloud in a natural, playful, conversational Thai voice. Sound confident, friendly, curious, and slightly cheeky, like a charismatic Thai creator casually sharing a fascinating discovery with a close friend. Keep the delivery flowing and connected, with a medium-fast pace and clear pronunciation. Use brief natural pauses only when they help comprehension. Never sound like a news presenter, announcer, advertisement, or formal narrator.

He speaks naturally with subtle blinking, breathing, a small head movement, and a gentle pointing gesture. A brilliant photon streak and distant spacecraft drift subtly behind him, cinematic stable camera push-in.
